text: でんきタイプの　わざ　だから　きかない　あいても　いるわよ

structure.jp: でんきタイプの　わざ　だから
きかない　あいても　いるわよ
structure.en: there are also opponents it doesn't work on

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what comes next. わざ　だから = 'because it's a move'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. きかない　あいて = 'opponents it doesn't work on'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft ending used by women in games and stories. いるわよ = 'there are, you know'.
